title: The home row
summary: The eight keys under your fingers on Malay (Jawi), and the space bar.
intro: This is Malay (Jawi) as it really is, and its home row, the eight keys every course starts from. The Malay course is built on another layout; this one has no course of its own yet. What there is, is the part that does not need words at all: each finger finding its key without looking, and coming back.
congrats: That is the home row of Malay (Jawi). The Malay course teaches the same habits on its own layout.
